description: Source code for the LP5569 LED driver, implementing LED control over I2C in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: lp5569_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specific LED by writing PWM value over I2C.

methods.name: lp5569_led_on
methods.description: Turns on a specific LED by setting brightness to 100%.

methods.name: lp5569_led_off
methods.description: Turns off a specific LED by setting brightness to 0%.

methods.name: lp5569_enable
methods.description: Enables the LP5569 device by writing to configuration registers.

methods.name: lp5569_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, possibly starting in off state if behind power domain.

methods.name: lp5569_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the device.
